core: Heart morphogenesis and mesoderm fate regulation
name: Mesoderm fate regulation and coronary and pericardial heart morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern mesodermal specification or heart morphogenesis; unlike the second-heart-field, chamber/trabecula and gastrulation confusables, this theme centres on coronary vascular smooth muscle/vasculogenesis, pericardium and regulation of mesoderm development.

name: NTF3-NTRK3 receptor signaling to Ras, PLCG1 and PI3K
rationale: Members describe NT-3 activation of TrkC and its adaptor-mediated (FRS2, ARMS) downstream Ras, PLCG1 and PI3K branches, distinguishing it from NGF-TRKA and NTRK2 confusables.

name: COPI-mediated Golgi-ER vesicle traffic and tethering
rationale: All members cover vesicle budding, targeting and tethering between ER and Golgi and within Golgi, with COPI retrograde/intra-Golgi traffic separating it from the COPII-export confusables.

name: Cardiolipin, phosphatidylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: Members are CDP-DAG/CDP-choline routes to CL, PG and PC plus CL/PG remodeling, unlike the confusables centred on PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or general acyl-chain remodeling and catabolism.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis
name: De novo purine synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated (d)NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine handling, distinguishing it from salvage/catabolism and antiviral-drug-metabolism confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis and assembly regulation
rationale: Members concern collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and fibril organisation and elastic fibre assembly, without the MMP-driven collagen degradation or basement membrane components of the confusables.

qualifier: cell death control and mitochondrial respiration regulation
name: Redox-stress cell death and mitochondrial respiration regulation
rationale: Members cover responses to peroxide, NO and reactive nitrogen species, the ferroptotic and intrinsic apoptotic deaths they trigger, and regulation of OXPHOS/respiration, which the ROS-detoxification and hypoxia confusables lack.

name: O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins
rationale: All members concern O-linked fucose/glucose glycosylation of Notch EGF repeats and thrombospondin repeats (including B3GLCT defect), unlike heparan sulfate, Hedgehog lipidation or N-glycan confusables.

name: Neuronal Ca2+/cAMP-CREB signaling and MECP2 transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link synaptic Ca2+/CaMK and adenylate cyclase-PKA signalling to CREB and MECP2/NPAS4 activity-dependent transcription and memory; confusables lack either the MECP2 or the PKA/CaMK-CREB arm.

name: ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4 receptor adaptor signaling
rationale: Members are SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K events downstream of ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4 dimers, distinguishing it from EGFR-centred and ERBB4 nuclear/downregulation confusables.

name: Global and transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair of UV damage
rationale: All members are NER steps for UV pyrimidine dimers, including both GG-NER recognition/incision and TC-NER, unlike translesion synthesis and UV-response confusables.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT-FOXO stress-response transcription
rationale: Members are NRF2 target-gene programs plus AKT control of FOXO localisation and FOXO-driven death/oxidative-stress genes, distinguishing it from UPR, p53/mTORC1 metabolic and NFE2L2-degradation confusables.

name: Pyrimidine nucleotide de novo synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo pyrimidine/UTP synthesis and (deoxy)pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on salvage/dNTP synthesis, purine synthesis or NTP sanitization.

core: Misfolded protein quality control and selective autophagy
name: Misfolded protein clearance and selective autophagy including pexophagy
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein responses, ERAD regulation, aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated, micro- and reticulophagy; pexophagy and membrane docking set it apart from the chaperonin-folding and stress-granule confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ leak channels and acid sensing
rationale: Members are K2P channel families setting resting potential plus acidic-pH responses, sour taste and TRP channels, which the pain, Ca2+-activated and KATP channel confusables lack.

qualifier: fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix
name: Fibroblast migration, focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover fibronectin matrix formation, integrins/syndecans, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly and fibroblast migration modules, without the MET-PTK2 or RHO-ROCK/PAK effectors of the confusables.

qualifier: autophagosome and endosome maturation, organelle size
name: Autophagosome and endosome maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members are fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and endosomes with lysosomes and regulation of autophagosome maturation and endosome/lysosome size, unlike the ESCRT and selective-autophagy confusables.

qualifier: creatine phosphotransfer and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleotide, NAD and creatine phosphotransfer with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, NAD/nicotinate metabolism, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide transport with permeabilisation, unlike CoA-synthesis and nucleoside-transporter confusables.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hedgehog and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipidated Hedgehog/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members span SMO/GLI Hedgehog signalling and the autoprocessing, palmitoylation and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, distinguishing it from DVL/Wnt, prenylation and non-canonical Wnt confusables.

name: Non-pigmentary MITF-M target gene regulation in melanocytes
rationale: Members are MITF-M programs for proliferation, survival, invasion, metabolism and lysosomes plus melanocyte differentiation, lacking the pigmentation and UV-response members of the confusables.

qualifier: UMP/CMP and nucleobase, with UMP salvage
name: Pyrimidine nucleobase and UMP/CMP catabolism and salvage
rationale: All members degrade or salvage pyrimidine (deoxy)ribonucleotides and bases, lacking the purine and deoxyribonucleoside (dGMP, dTMP) catabolism of the confusables.

name: Folate-dependent de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis
rationale: Members are de novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis plus tetrahydrofolate/10-formyl-THF metabolism, the folate arm being what all confusables lack.

core: Chromatin dynamics at DNA damage and replication
name: Repair- and replication-coupled chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleosome assembly/remodeling, protein recruitment to damaged chromatin, fork reversal and ADP-ribosylation regulation, unlike confusables centred on R-loops, DNA topology or replication-stress drug responses.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular helper co-stimulation
name: Germinal center B cell and T follicular helper differentiation
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, proliferation and germinal-center/memory differentiation with Tfh, ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation, which the B-1, naive B and humoral-response confusables lack.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling and NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signalling and NK cell differentiation/proliferation, distinguishing it from TCR, IL-3/IL-5 beta-common, IL-6/gp130 and IL-10/IL-12 family confusables.
